points.description: States that a stack is a data structure (or an equivalent idea such as a way/structure used to organize or store data).
States that a stack stores elements/items (data).
States the LIFO property: the item added last is the first one removed; accept 'last-in-first-out', 'LIFO', or equivalent Marathi/English wording.

rubric.notes: Full marks require saying that a stack is a data structure that stores elements and follows LIFO, i.e. the last-added item is removed first. Part marks are given for a partial definition, such as only identifying it as a data structure or only mentioning storage. Unrelated answers or answers that describe a different data structure earn no marks.
